prompts.overall: Rate the overall quality of this music recording on a scale from 1 (very bad) to 5 (excellent). Answer with a single digit from 1 to 5.
prompts.production: Rate the audio production quality of this recording (clarity, fidelity, absence of noise, distortion and glitches) on a scale from 1 (very bad) to 5 (excellent). Answer with a single digit from 1 to 5.
prompts.musical: Rate the musical quality of this recording (melody, harmony, rhythm, and how well the performance holds together) on a scale from 1 (very bad) to 5 (excellent). Answer with a single digit from 1 to 5.
prompts.professional: How likely is it that this is a professionally performed and produced music recording, on a scale from 1 (certainly not) to 5 (certainly)? Answer with a single digit from 1 to 5.

pair_prompt: This audio contains two music excerpts separated by a short silence. Which excerpt has the better overall quality, the first or the second? Answer with a single digit: 1 or 2.
explain_prompt: Listen to this music recording. In at most two short sentences (under 40 words in total), describe its most noticeable strengths or flaws in sound quality and musical performance. Then finish with "Rating: N", where N is a single digit from 1 (very bad) to 5 (excellent).
